scope: Code-level descriptions of CanonicalFlowBuilder outputs. This file does not assert dataset availability, scientific validity, or model provenance.

features.name: flow_duration
features.semantic_definition: Non-negative duration of the canonical flow.
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; required canonical inputs are used, and non-finite outputs are rejected by runtime schema validation.

features.name: flow_bytes_per_sec
features.semantic_definition: Total source and destination bytes divided by flow duration with a small denominator epsilon.
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; required canonical inputs are used, and non-finite outputs are rejected by runtime schema validation.

features.name: flow_pkts_per_sec
features.semantic_definition: Total source and destination packet counts divided by flow duration with a small denominator epsilon.
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; required canonical inputs are used, and non-finite outputs are rejected by runtime schema validation.

features.name: mean_pkt_size
features.semantic_definition: Total flow bytes divided by total packet count with a small denominator epsilon.
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; required canonical inputs are used, and non-finite outputs are rejected by runtime schema validation.

features.name: payload_byte_ratio
features.semantic_definition: Source bytes as a fraction of total flow bytes, clipped to [0, 1].
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; required canonical inputs are used, and non-finite outputs are rejected by runtime schema validation.

features.name: pkt_count_ratio
features.semantic_definition: Source packet count as a fraction of total flow packet count, clipped to [0, 1].
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; required canonical inputs are used, and non-finite outputs are rejected by runtime schema validation.

features.name: tcp_syn_ratio
features.semantic_definition: Source SYN count as a fraction of total flow packet count, clipped to [0, 1].
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; required canonical inputs are used, and non-finite outputs are rejected by runtime schema validation.

features.name: proto_tcp
features.semantic_definition: Indicator that the canonical flow protocol is TCP.
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; protocol is a required canonical input.

features.name: proto_udp
features.semantic_definition: Indicator that the canonical flow protocol is UDP.
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; protocol is a required canonical input.

features.name: proto_icmp
features.semantic_definition: Indicator that the canonical flow protocol is ICMP.
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; protocol is a required canonical input.

features.name: proto_other
features.semantic_definition: Indicator that the canonical flow protocol is not TCP, UDP, or ICMP.
features.transformation: 1 when protocol is not in {'tcp', 'udp', 'icmp'}, otherwise 0
features.missing_behavior: No imputation; protocol is a required canonical input.

features.name: temporal_iat_mean
features.semantic_definition: Per-source exponentially weighted mean of inter-arrival time; zero for the first event.
features.transformation: Causal EWMA of max(0, current_timestamp - previous_timestamp)
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); no imputation is performed.

features.name: temporal_iat_cv
features.semantic_definition: Per-source inter-arrival standard deviation divided by inter-arrival mean, clipped to [0, 100].
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); no imputation is performed.

features.name: temporal_flow_rate_ewma
features.semantic_definition: Per-source EWMA flow rate; initialized as inverse duration and subsequently updated from inter-arrival time.
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); no imputation is performed.

features.name: temporal_byte_rate_ewma
features.semantic_definition: Per-source EWMA of total flow bytes per second.
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); no imputation is performed.

features.name: temporal_syn_rate_ewma
features.semantic_definition: Per-source EWMA of the indicator that a flow has at least one source SYN.
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); no imputation is performed.

features.name: behavioral_dst_diversity
features.semantic_definition: Number of unique destinations in the source host's active sliding time window.
features.transformation: Unique dst_host count after expiring events older than window_seconds
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); empty windows produce zero.

features.name: behavioral_port_entropy
features.semantic_definition: Shannon entropy of destination-port frequencies in the source host's active sliding time window.
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); empty windows produce zero.

features.name: behavioral_fanout_ratio
features.semantic_definition: Unique active destination count divided by active event count, clipped to [0, 1].
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); empty windows produce zero.

features.name: behavioral_unanswered_ratio
features.semantic_definition: Fraction of active events whose connection state code is 1 or 2.
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); empty windows produce zero.

features.name: behavioral_src_activity_ewma
features.semantic_definition: Per-source EWMA updated once for each observed event.
features.transformation: EWMA of an event indicator with configured alpha
features.missing_behavior: State is reset explicitly by reset_state(); new sources start at zero.
